g.text: Every call is authenticated, yet a review on a hotel's web page decides who the Payment agent pays.
or forge one in your name
Believe the network is secure, and:
· anyone along the way can read or change a message
· any caller on the inside is trusted
· a guest's name pasted into a query runs as a command
Done right, you know who sent each message,
Fix: encrypt and authenticate every channel, check
(1) the Research agent restates the review as fact
(2) the orchestrator forwards the notes with the task
(3) the runtime pays whatever account the model names
Fix: build the payment task from the booking alone, and
check every Charge against the account on file.
